name: Kin-CRM
description: Kin is a self-hosted personal relationship manager built for neurodivergent brains (AuDHD, RSD, social anxiety). It helps you remember your people without the pressure. **What Kin does:** - Track people and relationships with rich profiles, tags, birthdays, and check-in cadences - Journal interactions -- log what happened, how much energy it cost, and attach photos from Immich - Resolve conflicts with an AI-assisted support chat and auto-generated resolution plans - Get gentle, never-punitive reminders to stay in touch - Gamification with achievements (including rest achievements like snoozing or grace mode) **First run:** Kin auto-detects an empty database and walks you through a setup wizard to create your admin account. No environment variables needed beyond what is shown below. **AI features (optional):** Set your OpenAI or Ollama API credentials in the Settings page after setup. Kin works perfectly without AI -- it falls back gracefully. **Immich integration (optional):** Connect your Immich server in Settings to attach face-linked photos to journal entries. **Database:** SQLite by default (stored in /data). Optionally connect to PostgreSQL via the DATABASE_URL variable.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent data directory (SQLite database, uploads, session secret).

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: HTTP port for the Kin web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run the container as. Ensures file ownership matches your Unraid users.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run the container as.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for daily scheduled jobs (birthday reminders, Instagram polling).

variables.name: Disable Scheduler
variables.description: Set to 1 to disable background scheduled jobs.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Optional PostgreSQL connection string. Leave empty to use the built-in SQLite database.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Optional fixed session secret. Auto-generated and persisted to /data if left empty.

variables.name: Allowed hosts
variables.description: Comma-separated hostnames this server accepts (e.g. example.com,*.example.com). Defaults to * for LAN/reverse-proxy setups.
